KILLED_FINDINGS.finding: The check-in rule is impossible to obey for rail arrivals. They require check-in one hour before departure while selling the 11:30 am cruise as the connection off a train arriving 11:15 am.
KILLED_FINDINGS.why_killed: THE ASTERISK RESOLVES IT AND THE COMPANY ALREADY HANDLES THIS. The fact-checker flagged the unresolved asterisk on the check-in sentence as load-bearing, and it was right to. The footnote reads verbatim: '*Passengers arriving by train and cruising on the 6 Hour Kenai Fjords National Park Cruise will have enough time to board the cruise if they proceed directly to the Major Marine Tours check-in office from the Railroad Depot.' The rule is explicitly carved out for exactly the case the finding claimed it broke. Had this shipped, the prospect could have opened their own page and disproved us in one line of small print.
KILLED_FINDINGS.status: CUT ENTIRELY. Must not appear in the study, the demo or the email in any form.

KILLED_FINDINGS.finding: A quoted FAQ sentence listing which boats are not wheelchair accessible.
KILLED_FINDINGS.why_killed: The quoted sentence does not exist. It was a reconstruction placed inside quotation marks. The real page presents it as a labelled list across separate sentences.
KILLED_FINDINGS.status: CUT. The underlying Rachel Marie discrepancy survives and is recorded below with correct wording.

UNCOVERED_BY_THE_GATE.warning: The fact-checker re-fetched only the four load-bearing industry sources, the Yonder pages, and the Major Marine and ownership pages. EVERYTHING ELSE in the competitor and industry sections is NOT verified and MUST NOT be cited as fact in the study.
specifically_not_verified: All competitor booking-platform findings except the Kenai Fjords Tours / Pursuit ownership disambiguation. That includes the Starboard Suite, FareHarbor and Phillips in-house findings, and the field-wide no-self-serve-cancellation observation.
All voice-of-customer material including the Google 4.9 aggregate and the Indeed rating.
The Seward cruise terminal opening, the $137 million figure and the 140,000-guest Royal Caribbean commitment.
All industry claims other than i1 through i7 above, including the Airbnb, Expedia, Booking Holdings, Arival, GetYourGuide, Ramp and commission-leakage figures.
UNCOVERED_BY_THE_GATE.consequence: If the study needs any of these, they must go back through a fact-check first. Otherwise the study is built only on the verified block above, which is substantial and sufficient.

DRIFT_PATTERN_NAMED_BY_THE_FACT_CHECKER.pattern: A SHARPENING REFLEX. Every quotation the research package RECONSTRUCTED rather than copied was reconstructed in the direction of the point it was being used to make.
instances: The FAQ accessibility answer is three tidy sentences in a labelled list on the page. The package rewrote it into one cluttered parenthetical sentence that reads like the site is a mess, which is exactly the finding it was supporting.

The 12-hour online booking cutoff, found on ONE reservation page, was generalised to 'reservation pages' plural, making the restriction look broader than proven, in a section arguing they are behind a competitor.
Yonder's 'potential' bookings became 'referred' bookings, and Yonder's marketing line was rewritten into a crisper overclaim. Both sharpened arguments the package wanted to make.
DRIFT_PATTERN_NAMED_BY_THE_FACT_CHECKER.counter_evidence: Two errors leaned the OTHER way, Gateway ownership under-asserted and '500+' reported as '500'. So this is a sharpening reflex rather than a systematic case against the prospect.
DRIFT_PATTERN_NAMED_BY_THE_FACT_CHECKER.the_rule_for_this_run: The sharpening happens at exactly the moment a quote is retyped from memory instead of copied. Every quote in the study must be copied from this file, never retyped. And the asterisk kill above is the same failure in its most dangerous form: a finding built from a rule while the exception printed on the same page went unread.

BINDING_CONSTRAINTS_ON_THE_STUDY: SEWARD ONLY. Never Whittier, never Prince William Sound, never 'two-port'.

NOTHING MAY IMPLY GUESTS COMPLAIN. Google is 4.9 from 2,555 reviews with about 2.4 percent at three stars or below, and not one verbatim negative guest review could be fetched. Every pain claim rests on their own published policies, which are hard fact.

NO SELF-SERVE CANCELLATION IS A FIELD-WIDE GAP, NOT A MAJOR MARINE DEFECT. No operator in Seward, Whittier or Valdez has it, including the NYSE-listed one. Writing it as their deficiency would be false and unfair.
WEBSITE DEFECTS MAY NEVER OPEN THE EMAIL and may never be a headline finding. The parking contradiction and the stale 2020/2021 copy are evidence at most.
NEVER NAME OR GUESS THEIR BOOKING ENGINE VENDOR.
NEVER WRITE A TENURE NUMBER FOR TOM TOUGAS. His is the one name on the page without one.
THE TOUGAS / KENAI FJORDS TOURS FOUNDING STORY IS UNVERIFIABLE AND BANNED.
THE CHECK-IN RULE IS NOT A PROBLEM. They footnote the rail case explicitly. Only the LATE train remains a manual decision.
